answer: No lamp is lit in the tower until the keeper has climbed every step and counted every window on the way. Proof of bookbinder press via stitch signature tally is the climbing: a book the binder sews only after 16 signatures are stitched, each counted by the binder and his wife. The tide is the first window, counted at the bottom; the onyx is the last, counted at the top. Lighting the lamp falsely takes a cheat 23 false climbs and 23 false windows, and the sonnet still stands dark over the harbour.
